03 /A little about me

Good software starts with

who use it.

I’m Melvin Gamana Jr., a software engineer with a background in full-stack web development. I work across modern frontend frameworks, backend services, and databases to turn requirements into dependable applications.

I enjoy untangling an old codebase as much as building something new. My focus is simple: readable code, thoughtful interfaces, and improvements that make a measurable difference.

I’m continuing to grow as an engineer, learning from the people I work with and sharing what I know along the way.
